subject: reasoning
question:
H, I, J, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between H and Q when counted from the left of Q. S sits third to the right of R. J sits third to the left of P. S sits to the immediate right of J.

I is not an immediate neighbour of J. How many people sit between I and Q when counted from the right of I?
solution:
• H, I, J, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.
 
• Only one person sits between H and Q when counted from the left of Q.
 
• S sits third to the right of R.
 
• J sits third to the left of P.
 
• S sits to the immediate right of J.
 
• I is not an immediate neighbour of J
